text:
Marta: Heads-up: deploy-bot blocked a preprod->prod promote due to values signature mismatch. Need quick decision.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE CHECK FAILED
preprod values hash: a1b2c3f
prod values hash: d4e5f6a
reason: differing key at `services.web.features.new_ui`

Alex: Who flipped that?

Sam: That was me for an internal smoke earlier. Forgot to sync prod.

Sasha: Two options: (A) patch prod with the flag (hotfix) or (B) revert preprod and re-run promotion. Which path minimizes risk?

Jay: Patch prod during the low-traffic window. Keep canary limited (10%) and short (10m).

Marta: Agreed. Sam, prepare a prod values update + chart patch. Also add conservative rollout settings.

Sam: Will submit a chart bump (1.3.2-hotfix), values-prod.yaml with `services.web.features.new_ui: true`. Helm command in PR.

Alex: Add readiness probe and `maxUnavailable: 1`. Use `--timeout 10m` for helm.

Oncall: I'll stand by and configure alerts. Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1% or sustained 5xx > 2x baseline for 5m.

deploy-bot: Suggested commands:
```
helm upgrade --install mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace prod --values values-prod.yaml --version 1.3.2-hotfix --set services.web.features.new_ui=true --timeout 10m --dry-run
helm upgrade --install mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace prod --values values-prod.yaml --version 1.3.2-hotfix --set services.web.features.new_ui=true --timeout 10m
```
Sasha: We'll annotate the release with `rollout.canary=10%` and `rollout.window=10m` so deploy-bot does the split automatically.

Sam: Draft release note: "1.3.2-hotfix: enable new_ui in prod for targeted smoke tests; 10% canary for 10m. Monitor and rollback if thresholds exceeded." PRs: chart -> https://github.com/redwood/mysvc-chart/pull/300, release-notes -> https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/432

Marta: Scheduling: 02:00 UTC today. We'll meet 01:50 UTC for final signoff. Oncall, confirm pager duty rule.

Oncall: Confirmed. I'll mute non-critical alerts and add temporary thresholds for this window.

Jay: I'll prepare the release-notes blurb and mark it ready to merge once Sam attaches the full PR.

Marta: Thanks team. We'll re-run deploy-bot preflight after PR merges and then promote. If anything looks off during canary we'll rollback to previous chart and revert the values. :thumbsup:
